## IColumnBuilder.isSearchable property

Whether the column is full-text searchable.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly isSearchable: boolean;
```

## Remarks

Flag form of the [IColumnBuilder.search()](./lmdb.icolumnbuilder.search.md) modifier — named `isSearchable` so it cannot collide with the `search()` method on the same object. Storage-only: it provisions a `{db}:search:{column}` posting table and never changes the row type.
